import type { FaviconContract, IconAsset } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
/** Use inside the actual document head for standalone SSR. Imports have no DOM effects. */
export declare function faviconLinks({ light, dark, touchIcon }: FaviconContract): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
export declare class Favicon extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        light: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        dark: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        touchIcon: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    light: IconAsset;
    dark: IconAsset | undefined;
    touchIcon: IconAsset | undefined;
    private links;
    private configuration;
    updated(): void;
    private clear;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
